summary: Read the course count n. Identifiers run from 0 up to n minus 1. Also read ordering rules, each given as a pair of identifiers: the first cannot begin until the second is finished. Write one sequence that includes every course. When several sequences work, any one of them is enough. If the rules form a loop so that at least one course can never begin, write an empty list of identifiers.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
